description: Root cause of '32 failing bun tests': plain 'bun test' (no --isolate) leaks mock.module overrides across test files — 21 test files use mock.module (e.g. automations-new.test.tsx mocks ../lib/api-client globally, breaking run-actions.test.ts; axios default-adapter mocks stop reaching components). The package.json test script IS 'bun test --isolate' and CI invokes the script, so CI is green. Always use 'bun run test' in apps/fabro-web, never bare 'bun test'. Same for workflow scripts: smoke test_typescript stage fixed 2026-08-21 (commit 28265c0f7).
resolution: Verified: bun 1.3.14 'bun run test' = 807 pass / 0 fail; 'bun test' = 32 fail. Not bun-version-specific (1.3.13, 1.3.14, 1.4.0 all fail without --isolate). Smoke workflow + AGENTS.md corrected (commit 28265c0f7); seed fabro-e16c closed as not-a-bug.

name: slow-write-sandbox-forces-race-interleaving
description: Force async read-modify-write interleaving in tool tests with SlowWriteMockSandbox (write_delay_ms sleep in write_file): instant mock writes let the first future finish before the second polls, hiding races a regression test must prove. Pattern proven in fabro-agent write-lock tests (PR #787): test fails on main, passes with lock.

name: sentinel-contract-test
description: Sentinel contract tests for wiring structs: when an options struct carries a primary value and its fallback (e.g. PublishOptions.pr_resolved_model vs pr_model), every fixture MUST set DISTINCT sentinel values and the test asserts which one arrives at the consumer. a1e27c9bf shipped a mis-wiring that six tests could not catch because all fixtures used the same value for both fields. Same-value fixtures blind tests to field confusion.
